name: hero-parallax
title: Hero Parallax
blurb: Scroll-driven 3D parallax gallery with rotating product cards.
description: Takes 300vh of viewport scrolling to animate 15 product cards (5 per row, 3 rows) with 3D perspective, opacity, and horizontal translate. Cards tilt and rotate on scroll, reverse direction per row. Spring damping smooths the parallax…
use_when: Showcase portfolio, case studies, or product gallery where scroll-depth matters.
avoid_when: Long on low-end devices (will tank performance with 15 parallax cards). Requires scroll listener.
a11y: Card images have alt text. Links are focusable but parallax breaks for keyboard nav (no prefers-reduced-motion).
